command:
set -u
NS=fwprobe$$
VH=fwvh$$
VN=fwvn$$
P8080=''
P8081=''
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$P8080" ]; then kill "$P8080" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  if [ -n "$P8081" ]; then kill "$P8081" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  sudo -n ip link del "$VH" 2>/dev/null || true
  sudo -n ip netns del "$NS" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f /tmp/fwprobe-8080.$$ /tmp/fwprobe-8081.$$
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
sudo -n ip netns add "$NS"
sudo -n ip link add "$VH" type veth peer name "$VN"
sudo -n ip link set "$VN" netns "$NS"
sudo -n ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$VH"
sudo -n ip link set "$VH" up
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set lo up
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$VN"
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set "$VN" up
nc -l -s 192.0.2.1 8080 >/tmp/fwprobe-8080.$$ 2>&1 & P8080=$!
nc -l -s 192.0.2.1 8081 >/tmp/fwprobe-8081.$$ 2>&1 & P8081=$!
sleep 1
printf '%s\n' '--- temporary listeners prove both target ports have a server ---'
ss -ltn | grep -E '192\.0\.2\.1:(8080|8081)'
printf '%s\n' '--- isolated external-path probes ---'
if sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" nc -z -w 2 192.0.2.1 22; then echo 'PASS tcp/22 accepted'; else echo 'FAIL tcp/22 not accepted'; exit 1; fi
if sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" nc -z -w 2 192.0.2.1 8080; then echo 'PASS tcp/8080 accepted'; else echo 'FAIL tcp/8080 not accepted'; exit 1; fi
if sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" nc -z -w 2 192.0.2.1 8081; then echo 'FAIL unrelated tcp/8081 accepted'; exit 1; else echo 'PASS unrelated tcp/8081 rejected'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- relevant packet counters ---'
sudo -n iptables -L ufw-user-input -n -v --line-numbers
sudo -n iptables -L ufw-reject-input -n -v --line-numbers | sed -n '1,20p'

printf '%s\n' '--- post-reboot packet counters ---'
sudo -n iptables -L ufw-user-input -n -v --line-numbers
sudo -n iptables -L ufw-reject-input -n -v --line-numbers | sed -n '1,20p'

set -u
printf 'BOOT_ID=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
NS=fwpost$$
VH=fpvh$$
VN=fpvn$$
P8080=''
P8081=''
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$P8080" ]; then kill "$P8080" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  if [ -n "$P8081" ]; then kill "$P8081" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  sudo -n ip link del "$VH" 2>/dev/null || true
  sudo -n ip netns del "$NS" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f /tmp/fwpost-8080.$$ /tmp/fwpost-8081.$$
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
sudo -n ip netns add "$NS"
sudo -n ip link add "$VH" type veth peer name "$VN"
sudo -n ip link set "$VN" netns "$NS"
sudo -n ip addr add 192.0.2.1/30 dev "$VH"
sudo -n ip link set "$VH" up
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set lo up
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip addr add 192.0.2.2/30 dev "$VN"
sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set "$VN" up
nc -l 192.0.2.1 8080 >/tmp/fwpost-8080.$$ 2>&1 & P8080=$!
nc -l 192.0.2.1 8081 >/tmp/fwpost-8081.$$ 2>&1 & P8081=$!
sleep 1
printf '%s\n' '--- post-reboot temporary listeners ---'
ss -ltn | grep -E '192\.0\.2\.1:(8080|8081)'
printf '%s\n' '--- post-reboot isolated external-path probes ---'
if sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" nc -z -w 2 192.0.2.1 22; then echo 'PASS tcp/22 accepted'; else echo 'FAIL tcp/22 not accepted'; exit 1; fi
if sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" nc -z -w 2 192.0.2.1 8080; then echo 'PASS tcp/8080 accepted'; else echo 'FAIL tcp/8080 not accepted'; exit 1; fi
if sudo -n ip netns exec "$NS" nc -z -w 2 192.0.2.1 8081; then echo 'FAIL unrelated tcp/8081 accepted'; exit 1; else echo 'PASS unrelated tcp/8081 rejected'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- post-reboot packet counters ---'
sudo -n iptables -L ufw-user-input -n -v --line-numbers
sudo -n iptables -L ufw-reject-input -n -v --line-numbers | sed -n '1,20p'
